title: Steel Arms
description: Complete a drop block without using your feet (campus style).

title: Silent Feet
description: Climb a route without your feet making noise when touching the holds.

title: The Statue
description: Stay stable on each hold for 5 seconds.

title: Absurd Speed
description: Finish a low level boulder in under 15 seconds.

title: Blind Stick
description: Memorize the block and climb with your eyes closed.

title: The Master Hook
description: Overcome a step using a mandatory heel or instep hook (kick)

title: Zen Balance
description: Release both hands and stay on your feet alone for 10s.

title: Leap of Faith
description: Throw a two-handed dynamic towards distant prey.

title: Iron Finger
description: Complete a route using only two fingers per hand on large holds.

title: Dance Step
description: Do a change of feet by jumping (without touching the wall) on a small hold.

title: The Aragonese
description: Make yourself a block on campus with your feet flexed towards your back.

title: The Spider
description: Climb always maintaining 3 points of contact with the wall.

title: Thumbless
description: Complete a block without using your thumb to clamp any hold.

title: Vertical Yoga
description: Raise one foot to hand height before progressing to the next hold.

title: Relays
description: As a couple: you climb the first half and your partner the second without going down.

title: The Pendulum
description: Do a lateral movement by jumping and swinging with one arm.

title: Tyrannosaurus Rex
description: Climb keeping your elbows close to your ribs at all times.

title: Limit Resistance
description: Go up and down the same block 3 times in a row without touching the ground.

title: Hands Back
description: Cross a section of plate without using your hands.

title: Crystal Wall
description: You cannot use any volume of the wall, only the dams in place.

title: Spagat
description: Keep both feet on holds at least 1.5 meters apart during one step.

title: flashmob
description: 3 people must be in the same block, at the same time, crossing each other.

title: Crab Claw
description: You can only use holds that allow a pincer grip.

title: The Astronaut
description: Move each hand and foot extremely slowly (3s per movement).

title: Investment
description: Finish the block hanging only by your feet (bat-hang).

title: Precision Throw
description: Throw a dynamic and land with only one hand on the target prey.

title: The Table
description: Keep your body fully stretched in a slump.

title: Without Own Feet
description: Climb without using foot holds (you can use hand holds for support)

title: Battery Charging
description: Rest on a hold for 30 seconds with one arm and then another 30 with the other.

title: Triple Tap
description: Before grabbing the next hold, touch it 3 times with your hand.

title: One Arm
description: Climb a full low-grade route using only your non-dominant arm.

title: Toe-Heel
description: Perform a movement where you use the tip of one foot and the heel of the other.

title: Synchrony
description: Find someone and do the same block at the same time.

title: Frog Jump
description: Do a movement where both feet jump at the same time to new holds.

title: Zero Errors
description: If you miss a move or slip a foot, you have to start from scratch.

title: Perfect Dihedral
description: Climb a corner using only opposition technique (pushing yourself against walls).

title: Fair Monkey
description: Climb a short section with just your legs.

title: Acid Resistance
description: Do 10 pull-ups on a hold with a good grip, before starting the block.

title: The Mime
description: Climb without looking at your hands, you can only look at your feet.

title: Final Sprint
description: Do a block, completing the last 4 movements in less than 3 seconds.

title: Cat Feet
description: Climb using only the extreme balls of your feet on each support.

title: No Thumbs
description: Prohibited from using the thumb in any grip (open hand only).

title: The Crane
description: Stay on one foot 10 seconds before each dynamic step.

title: Double Dynamic
description: Do a block, completing at least one dynamic double, throwing both hands simultaneously to the next hold.

title: Blind Climbing
description: Close your eyes right after touching the first hold with your hand.

title: The Pendulum
description: Use a leg swing to gain momentum in a side step.

title: Zero Oxygen
description: Do 5 movements in a row while holding your breath.

title: Giant's Pass
description: Skip a medium-hand hold by using a very high foot.

title: Mirror Mode
description: Exactly copy the movements your partner next to you makes.

title: Total Voltage
description: Don't let any part of your clothing touch the wall when climbing.

title: Terminal strip
description: Complete a block that only has strip holds.

title: Crossing of Hands
description: Perform at least two different arm crossings before reaching the top.

title: The Chimney
description: Hold for 10 seconds, resting your back on the wall and your feet on the opposite wall. (Do it in a corner)

title: Infinite Journey
description: Travel 10 lateral meters without touching the ground.

title: One Foot
description: Climb an easy block using only your right foot (the left one dangles).

title: Shoulder Touch
description: Touch your opposite shoulder before each new hand grip.

title: Step of Faith
description: Complete the block looking up, be careful not to step on other blocks' prey.

title: Shared Load
description: Hold your partner so he can reach a top.

title: Arrowhead
description: Make a 'deadpoint': reach the prey at the point of zero gravity.

title: Soft Hands
description: You cannot reposition any hand; Wherever it falls, there it stays.

title: Scorpion
description: Do a heel hook above the height of your head.

title: Lock at 120
description: Keep your arm almost straight but in tension for 3 seconds before moving.

title: The Clock
description: You have exactly 20 seconds to finish; neither one more nor one less.

title: Pure Adhesion
description: Use only the palms of your hands (no fingers) on blunt holds.

title: Side Step
description: Cross one leg behind the other for support.

title: Mental Resistance
description: Hangs from a 10s strip at the end of a hard block.

title: Clap
description: Use the hand opposition technique (one pushes, one pulls) on a block.

title: Long jump
description: Do a lateral dynamic more than a meter away.

title: The Final Clamp
description: Finish the block by holding the 'top' with just a clamp in your hands

title: Equilibrist
description: Cross a volume by walking on it without using your hands.

title: Echo Way
description: During the rest of the rounds, you agree to say the color of the prey you touch, otherwise the rest of the challenges will be cancelled.

title: Three Fingers
description: You can only use index, middle and ring fingers in the entire route.

title: Rubber sole
description: Clean your feet before climbing; You can't leave a mark on the wall.

title: Helping Hand
description: Reach for the top while shaking hands with someone on the floor.

title: Historic puncture
description: Throw a dynamic but stay completely still when receiving it.

title: Bicycle
description: Make a bicycle.

title: Blunts without Magnesium
description: Complete a blunt block without using magnesium on your hands.

title: Iron Lumbars
description: In a collapse, keep your feet together even if your hands move.

title: Reverse Climbing
description: Start at the top and go down to the start in a controlled manner.

title: 360 coordination
description: Twist around into a standing hold before continuing up.

title: Flexo-Extension
description: Stretch your arm completely before going for each new prey.

title: Harakiri
description: Get on a block, and fall dramatically. The rest vote on whether it was realistic or not.

title: The Anchor
description: Keep one foot hooked while moving both hands in succession.

title: Elbow Up
description: Always keep your elbows above the level of your hands.

title: Dwarf Pass
description: Use only the foot holds closest to your hands.

title: Indomitable Finger
description: Scale using only the index finger of each hand.

title: Force of Gravity
description: Release your feet in the final movement and finish with your arms alone.

title: Slow Motion
description: It takes exactly 5 seconds to close each hand grip.

title: Symphony of Feet
description: Every time you move one foot, you must touch the wall with the same foot 2 times before.

title: The Bridge
description: Keep your feet and hands on different walls and blocks (4 blocks) you have 20 seconds RUN!

title: Without looking
description: Once you grab a hold, you can't look at your feet again.

title: Double Tap
description: Touch your knee with your free hand before moving to the next one.

title: Bear Hug
description: Climb a large volume by surrounding it with both arms at the same time.

title: Ballerina Point
description: Stand only on your big toe on tiny holds.

title: Static Resistance
description: Stay blocked in the middle of the boulder for 20 seconds.

title: Somersault
description: Do a foot dynamic at a volume and stay balanced.

title: Reverse Hand
description: Use at least one hand grip in an 'inverted' position.

title: manual flip
description: In the middle of the block, take an object out of your pocket, throw it into the air so that it spins around, and pick it up again without it falling.

title: The Monkey
description: Swing while hanging on one hand before jumping to the next.

title: Crossing of Feet
description: Do a change of feet without using the wall, only by direct contact.

title: Extreme Flexibility
description: Put your foot on the same hold where you have your hand.

title: Without Breathing
description: Complete the last 3 movements in apnea.

title: Middle Finger
description: Make a clamp using only your middle finger and thumb.

title: Ant Pass
description: Use at least 10 different footrests.

title: Direct Launch
description: Dynamic from the ground to the third hand hold.

title: Slap
description: Claps the air between two hand holds.

title: Heel strike
description: Keep one heel on for 3 consecutive hand movements.

title: Ice Plate
description: Climb a plate without using your hands for balance, just your feet.

title: Heart Rate
description: Climb to the rhythm of the music playing in the climbing wall.

title: Double Clamp
description: Hold two clamps at the same time and let your feet dangle for 2 seconds.

title: Tennis Elbow
description: Climb without flexing your right arm more than 45 degrees.

title: Lead feet and shame
description: Every time you move your foot, drop it hard (make a lot of noise).

title: The Claw
description: Use only your fingertips.

title: Wrist Spin
description: Rotate your hand 360 degrees before bringing it to each prey.

title: Giant's Step 2
description: Open your legs as much as possible in a vertical section.

title: Side Climbing
description: Complete the block always looking to the right.

title: Two Hands
description: You can only move your hands if both go to new prey at the same time.

title: Total Resistance
description: Go up, down and up the same block again without resting. (To win do it 10 times)

title: The Guide
description: Dictate the steps to a partner while you climb another block. He must listen to you, if he doesn't, you don't earn points.

title: Foot Touch
description: Touch your foot with your hand before grabbing the next hold.

title: Iron Lock
description: Block with one hand while touching the back of your neck with the other.

title: No Hands
description: Cross a 2 meter section of plate without using your hands.

title: Push
description: Use the 'mantle' technique to get up to high volume.

title: Little finger
description: Use your pinky for support in at least one hand grip.

title: Toecap
description: Use only the extreme tip of the jack on a grip pad.

title: Leap Frog 2
description: Dynamic feet on two different supports at the same time.

title: The Statue of Salt
description: Don't move for 10 seconds in the most difficult position on a block.

title: Magic Crossing
description: Cross your legs in front in a balancing side step.

title: Hand in Jug
description: Keep one hand on your waist for 2 movements of the other.

title: Head Balance
description: Rest your forehead on the wall to gain balance in one step.

title: Dance Step 2
description: Change feet by doing a small jump in the air.

title: Stiff Arm
description: Climb a short block with your left arm fully extended.

title: Top touch
description: Touch the top with both hands at the same time after a jump.

title: Under pressure
description: Someone must time you; If you go over 15s, you fail.

title: Extreme Adhesion
description: Use only the friction of the climbing shoes against the smooth wall.

title: War Cry
description: He screams as he performs the hardest move on the block.

title: Hand on back
description: He reaches the top with one hand behind his back.

title: Compass Step
description: Open one leg 90 degrees to the side to stabilize yourself and complete a block.

title: Three Points
description: Always keep 3 limbs fixed before moving the fourth.

title: Explosive Ending
description: Throw a dynamic at the last hold on the block.

title: Green Forest
description: Complete a block using only green holds.

title: Fire in the Hands
description: Make all the red blocks you find in the same area.

title: Blue Sky
description: Climb a route where at least 50% of the holds are blue.

title: Pure Dynamic
description: Complete a block that requires dynamic movement.

title: The Kingdom of Romo
description: Overcome a block that only has blunt holds (no sharp edges).

title: Deadly Rules
description: Climb a route that is predominantly small bars.

title: Yellow Obsession
description: Use only yellow hand holds; the feet are free.

title: Volume Zone
description: Complete a block where you use at least 3 different volumes.

title: Black Monochrome
description: Climb the hardest black route you are able to finish.

title: Crystal dihedral
description: Climb a dihedral area (inner corner) without using foot holds.

title: Crab Claws
description: Find a block that has clamps and do it squeezing with maximum force.

title: Orange Invasion
description: Touch 10 different orange holds before reaching the top.

title: The Gray Crash
description: Overcome any block on the steepest wall in the room.

title: Sharp Edge
description: Climb along the edge of the wall using only lateral holds.

title: Only Jugs
description: Make a difficult block using only the largest holds (jugs).

title: Under the Roof
description: Complete a block that runs entirely along a horizontal roof.

title: Straight Layout
description: Climb a route that goes up in a completely vertical line, without deviating.

title: Double Color
description: Only use prey of two specific colors (e.g. red and blue).

title: Colorful Feet
description: The hands go along the route, but the feet can only touch white prey.

title: Wooden Top
description: If there are wooden holds, complete a block that uses at least one.

title: Forbidden Route
description: It picks a block and decides that one of its key holds is 'off-limits'.

title: Extreme Adhesion
description: Find a lying plate and climb it without using hand holds.

title: Initiation Wall
description: Make 5 different blocks in the kids/beginners area in a row.

title: The Launch
description: Look for a block with an initial jump from the ground.

title: Strips of Three
description: Use only 3 fingers on each track strip.

title: Lucky Color
description: Have a partner choose a color; you must make 3 blocks of that color.

title: Lower Traverse
description: Make a long trip using only holds that are less than 1m away.

title: Phantom Dam
description: Climb a route, jumping every third hold.

title: Only Feet in Volume
description: Use volumes only for your feet, never for your hands.

title: Vertical Rainbow
description: Touch a hold of each color available on the wall before the top.

title: Competition Block
description: Try the rarest or most modern block you see equipped.

title: Left Hand Green
description: Only the left hand can touch green prey.

title: Blunt Challenge 2
description: Hold a 5-second hold on each blunt grip on the block.

title: Feet on the Wall
description: Do not use foot holds, only the grip of the shoe on the wall.

title: Hot Route
description: Complete a warm color block (Red, Orange, Yellow).

title: Cold Route
description: Complete a cold color block (Blue, Green, Violet).

title: The Monofinger
description: Find a hole and use it with just one finger (carefully).

title: Jug Jump
description: Dynamic from a power strip to a large jug.

title: Volume Balance
description: Stand on a volume without using your hands for 15 seconds.

title: Triple Color
description: Climb using Red, Green and Yellow holds only.

title: The Short Roof
description: Overcome a 45-degree drop using only small holds.

title: Zig Zag Color
description: Alternate between two-color holds with each movement.

title: Outlet Dam
description: Keep your hands on the starting hold for 10s before moving.

title: Maximum Incline
description: Make a crossing through the place where the wall is steepest.

title: White Spots
description: Only use holds that have white marks from old magnesium.

title: The Color Bridge
description: Do a split between two holds of different colors.

title: Zero Black Feet
description: Complete a block while avoiding stepping on any black prey.

title: Red Right Hand
description: Your right hand can only touch red-colored prey.

title: The King of Rules
description: Make 3 routes in a row that only have power strips.

title: Color Top
description: The top must be a different color than the rest of the block.

title: Output Volume
description: Start the block with both feet placed on a volume.

title: No Blue Feet
description: Complete your favorite block without using any of its blue foot holds.

title: Finger and Pliers
description: On orange holds, you can only use pincer grip.

title: The Gray Fireplace
description: Climb around a corner using opposition technique on the gray walls.

title: Rainbow Journey
description: Walk the entire wall from side to side touching all the colors.

title: Only New Dams
description: Only use the cleanest or newest looking holds on the block.

title: Setter Challenge
description: Try to complete the block exactly as the outfitter intended.

title: Single Yellow Hand
description: Use only one hand for all the yellow holds on the block.

title: Free Feet, Green Hands
description: Feet anywhere, hands only on green holds.

title: The Grand Finale
description: Jump from the penultimate hold to the top, whatever color it is.

title: The Octopus
description: You can only move one limb at a time. The other three must remain still at all times.

title: Return to the Tortilla
description: Rotate 180 degrees on your axis in the middle of the block, changing your orientation relative to the wall.

title: The Ballast
description: Climb with your backpack on (with some weight inside, e.g. rope, water, or a small dumbbell).

title: Blades
description: The entire route must be done with edge grip (only use the lateral edge of the holds).

title: Serpent's Tongue
description: Stick out your tongue with every movement. If you forget, the challenge fails.

title: The Director
description: Your partner tells you which hand or foot to move at each moment. Absolute obedience.

title: Blind Spot
description: Put a post-it in the center of your sunglasses/climbing goggles. Climb without being able to see through it.

title: The Anchor II
description: Keep one hand on a hold for at least 3 foot movements.

title: 100 Inches
description: Separate your hands as far as possible in one step. The minimum distance is your height.

title: Airplane Mode
description: Turn off your cell phone. You cannot look at any photos or videos of the block before trying it.

title: Silent Ninja
description: Combines 'Silent Feet' and 'Gentle Hands'. Not a sound of feet, not a readjustment of hands.

title: The Hanged Man
description: Hang from a hold with one arm and touch your opposite foot with your free hand for 3 seconds.

title: Tandem
description: Couple climbing: both on the boulder at the same time, at least one of the two must always be touching the other.

title: Myopic
description: Climb without glasses (if you use them) or with sunglasses on. (If you have good eyesight, close one eye).

title: The Crab II
description: Climb a section of overhang, always moving sideways (progressing forward is prohibited).

title: Butter
description: Wash your hands with water. No magnesium in this block.

title: The Crane II
description: Each time you release one hand, you should keep your leg raised and straight for 2 seconds.

title: Paradox
description: Swing toward a hold with your hand, but the moving foot must land BEFORE the hand lands on its new hold.

title: The Astrologer
description: Before each movement, say out loud a direction (up, left, diagonal...) and move exactly in that direction.

title: The Titan
description: Choose a high grade block for yourself. You MUST chain it on the first attempt (flash) or the challenge is considered failed.

title: Mountaineer
description: Climb with the cats in the backpack. You can only use bare feet (carefully, on clean, blunt holds).

title: Rag Doll
description: Relax your entire body except your arms and hands in a slump step.

title: The Corridor
description: Make 4 low level blocks, but you have to run from one to the other. Rest time is how long it takes you to run.

title: Back to the Roots
description: You can only use holds of the color of the tape that marks the exit of the block.

title: Quires
description: Four-finger bridge grip (four fingers together on top, thumb loose) on all holds.

title: The Top Model
description: You have to pose for 3 seconds in an aesthetic position before picking up the top.

title: The Speleologist
description: Climb a block indoors, but with your face facing the ground at all times (without raising your head).

title: Rebound
description: Each hold must be released with a small controlled jump to go to the next.

title: The Outfitter
description: Your friends choose the holds you will have to climb on a new invented block and you have to do it.

title: Lead Feet
description: Keep your feet against the wall at all times (not a millimeter apart).

title: The Top Is Not the End
description: After touching the top, go down where you came up without jumping. Controlled ground touch.

title: Power Grip
description: Shout 'Power!' every time you close your hand on a hold. If you don't scream, the grip is worthless.

title: The Matador
description: Dodge a large volume (as if it were charging at you) while climbing. You can't use it or touch it.

title: Claustrophobia
description: Climb a section of dihedral or chimney as close to the walls as possible, feeling the pressure.

title: Bass Solo
description: If the block has a ceiling step, you MUST do it with your feet above your hands (inverted).

title: The Hypnotist
description: You cannot blink while performing the last 3 moves.

title: Broken Line
description: The block must be climbed in two steps: go up 2 movements, go down 1, go up 3, go down 1... until the top. (Linear progress prohibited).

title: The Grasshopper
description: The entire block must be done with jumps. Any static movement is prohibited.

title: Pool
description: Each time you grab a hold, shake your arm (as if drops are falling on you) before the next movement.

title: Group Top
description: Gather 4 people. Together, they must chain the same block, making one movement each.

title: Fists of Steel
description: Climb a plate or blunt block using only closed fists instead of open hands.

title: The Forbidden Route (II)
description: Today you can't step on the climbing wall floor between blocks. Move along the mattresses or jump from one block to another without falling.

title: The One-Eyed One
description: Patch your dominant eye (or close one) for the entire block.

title: Extreme Gripper
description: Find a ridge or small prey and make a clamp with your thumb and middle fingers (the rest extended).

title: Nightmare on the Plate
description: Stick your feet to the wall on a plate, release your hands and hold the position for 5 seconds.

title: Support Point
description: Before you start, choose a midpoint on the block. You can only rest there, nowhere else.

title: The Translator
description: Translate the name of the block (if it has one) into another language and say it out loud before each move.

title: Rope and Carabiner
description: Simulate a leading climb: every 2 movements, pretend to clip the rope to an imaginary carabiner.

title: Rock Spirit
description: Close your eyes. Your partner guides you with his voice to overcome 3 key movements.

title: The Collector
description: While climbing a block, touch 5 holds of a color NOT the color of the block you are climbing.

title: Paradox 2: The Return
description: In a dynamic step, the hand releasing the hold must touch the new hold BEFORE the driving foot loses contact with the wall.

title: The 7 Lives
description: You have 7 lives. Every small mistake (re-adjustment, foot noise, micro-slip) subtracts a life. If you reach 0, hit the ground.

title: The Mirror Climber
description: Stand in front of a glass or reflective surface (if there is one) and climb looking at your reflection.

title: Fair Jumpsuit II
description: Now the other way around: climb a section of overhang with just your hands, feet dangling.

title: Single file
description: 3 climbers, 1 block. They come out one by one. The second cannot use any prey that the first used.

title: Rubber Ankles
description: Every time you move your foot, you must rotate it 360 degrees in the air before landing it on the new hold.

title: Mercilessly
description: Choose a block you've never tried or that scares you. It's your only attempt of the day.

title: Vertical Yoga II
description: In one step, bring your knee to your chest and hold it for 3 seconds before continuing.

title: The Postman
description: Hand a small object (e.g. a magnesator) to a partner who is climbing another block, without getting off yours.

title: Anti-Gravity
description: Make a block, keeping your hips against the wall at all times.

title: The Ninja II
description: In addition to silent feet, your hands also cannot make noise when gripping prey.

title: The Mole
description: Dig into the magnesium in your pocket before each move. A cloud should be seen.

title: Brute Force
description: On a strength step, do 3 push-ups before continuing.

title: Airplane Mode II
description: Disconnect WiFi and data. No social media until you finish 3 challenges.

title: Butter Fingers
description: Wash your hands with soap. No magnesium in this block.

title: The Owl
description: Turn your head 180 degrees (as much as you can) to look at the next prey before going for it.

title: Human Pendulum
description: In a lunge step, swing 3 times before launching yourself to the next hold.

title: The Claw II
description: Half bolus grip: just the palm of the hand, without using fingers.

title: The Architect
description: Draw the exact line you are going to follow with chalk before you begin. Follow it to the letter.

title: Stilts
description: Only use standing holds that are at chest height or higher.

title: The Fencer
description: In a dihedral step, keep one leg stretched back for balance, like in fencing.

title: Third Time
description: With each hand hold, touch your opposite elbow with your other hand before releasing it.

title: Helping Hand II
description: Reach the top while shaking hands with a partner who is also on another nearby block.

title: Sprint Final II
description: Shout 'SPRINT' and do the last 3 moves at maximum speed.

title: Inverse Balance
description: Climb keeping the weight back, as if you wanted to fall outwards in a fall.

title: The Collector II
description: You have to touch 3 holds of each color of the rainbow (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple) before the top.

title: The Fallen
description: Find the most collapsed block in the climbing wall and chain it. The degree does not matter, only the inclination.

title: Ice Wall
description: Pretend that you are cold: tap your feet lightly on each hold before putting them down completely.

title: The Mime II
description: Now the other way around: climb without looking at your feet, you can only look at your hands.

title: The Monk
description: Climb in absolute silence. If you speak, the challenge fails. Sign communication.

title: Iron Clamp
description: Hold a coin or small stone with your free hand as you climb. You can't fall.

title: Synchrony II
description: Find someone and do the same block at the same time, but synchronize each movement at the same time.

title: The Warrior
description: Paint war stripes on your face with magnesium before starting the block.

title: Zero Gravity
description: Do a dynamic movement where, at the highest point, you release the hand you are going to catch and clap before grabbing again.

title: Under the Arm
description: You can only use holds that are below the height of your armpit.

title: The Acrobat
description: Do a cartwheel or backflip block on the mat just before you start climbing.

title: Stone Hand
description: Clench your fist with the hand that is not on the grip for 5 seconds with each movement.

title: The Archaeologist
description: Find the oldest, most worn-out hold in the climbing gym and make a block that includes it.

title: Crystal Wall II
description: Now you cannot use any volume of the wall, only the placed holds and also the colored holds of the block.

title: Double Dynamic II
description: Throw a dynamic double at holds with hands that are at different heights.

title: The Crystal Ball
description: Guess the grade of the block before reading the sheet metal. If you fail by more than 2 degrees, the challenge is not worth it.

title: The Jumper
description: Before starting the block, do 10 jumping jacks. The fatigue is real.

title: Heel Touch
description: Every time you move one foot, touch the opposite glute with your heel before landing.

title: Circular Climbing
description: Climb a block, but before you reach the top, you have to go all the way around the wall (if it is a free-standing block).

title: The Artist
description: Do a yoga pose (downward facing dog, cobra, etc.) in the middle of the block and hold it for 5 seconds.

title: Cat's Feet II
description: Now only with the inside of the foot (instep) on each support.

title: The Wizard
description: Make a movement where it seems like you're levitating: hold the position for 2 seconds between releasing a hold and grabbing the next one.

title: Relay race
description: In a group of 3, each one of you do a block, without repeating, and passing an object (e.g. your cell phone) as a witness.

title: The Chimney II
description: Now in an open corner: hold 10s in opposition with hands on one wall and feet on the other (open dihedral).

title: The Centennial
description: Chain 3 blocks in a row of different and consecutive difficulties without going down to the ground.

title: Iron Thumb
description: You can only use grips where the thumb applies active pressure (clamps, power grips). Open grip without thumb is prohibited.

title: The Seeker
description: Look for a block that has a strange or funny shaped hold on it. Point to it and name it before you start.

title: Reverse Hand II
description: Use at least one hand grip in an 'inverted' position with each hand.

title: Leap Frog 3
description: Do a movement where both feet jump at the same time to new holds, but the hands also move at the same time to new holds.

title: The Tailor
description: Grab the exit hold with both hands and, without releasing them, put one leg over your arm (like a tailor).

title: The Whistler
description: Whistle a song while you climb. If you stop whistling, challenge failed.

title: Dance Step 3
description: Shift your feet in the air with a small 90-degree turn before landing on the new hold.

title: The Horse
description: Overcome a ceiling step or collapse with a backward kick like a horse.

title: The Battleship
description: Climb a block without bending your knees at any time (stiff legs).

title: Mirror Mode II
description: Copy exactly the movements your partner next to you makes, but he is doing a different block.

title: Total Tension II
description: Now no part of your body can touch the wall except your feet and hands. No knees, hips, etc.

title: The Heartbreaker
description: Try a block you've failed many times before. Today is the day.

title: The Claw III
description: Deep grip grip with fingers curled like a claw. Maximum tension of phalanges.

title: The Painter
description: Imagine that you have a brush in your hand and you must paint the wall before putting your foot down.

title: Secret Code
description: Before you start, assign a color to each movement. Ex: red=left hand, blue=right foot... and follow it.

title: The Gymnast
description: Do a handstand (against the wall or free) for 3 seconds before starting the block.

title: The Night Climber
description: Turn off the lights on your cell phone. Scale with as little light as possible. If there is little light in the room, the better.

title: Clamp and Finger
description: Alternate a pincer grip with a single-finger grip on the same hand in consecutive movements.

title: The Mute
description: Communicate a message to your partner (e.g. the next block) only with gestures while climbing.

title: The Dock
description: Every time you reach a hold, do a little bounce with your legs before stabilizing yourself.

title: The Collector III
description: You have to touch 2 holds of each color of the climbing wall (white, black, gray included) before the top.

title: Little Finger II
description: Use ONLY the little finger of each hand to grab a hold. The rest of the fingers do not touch.

title: The King of Blunt
description: Make 3 blunt blocks in a row. (If there are none, look for the most rounded ones).

title: Anklet
description: Put an elastic band or rubber band on your ankles. You cannot separate your feet more than the rubber allows.

title: The Mole II
description: It digs into the magnesium of the pocket before each move and leaves a visible mark on the prey.

title: Zero Errors II
description: If you miss a move or slip a foot, you have to start from scratch. Also, if you readjust a hand, too.

title: The Warrior II
description: Before you start, make 3 magnesium stripes on each cheek. Battle cry included.

title: Symphony of Feet II
description: Every time you move one foot, you must touch the wall with the same foot 3 times before, with different intensity (little, medium, strong).

title: The Astronomer
description: Stare at an overhead light for 5 seconds before starting. Scales with spots on the retina.

title: Iron Hand
description: In a power step, release one hand and touch the opposite shoulder before grabbing again.

title: The Wizard Merlin
description: Make a movement where it appears that you are levitating for 3 seconds between holds (it is prohibited to touch the wall with your feet during that period).

title: The Firefighter
description: Slide down a tube or structure (if there is one) between blocks.

title: The Falcon
description: Sight a block from afar and plan the beta without getting close. Then go and do it exactly how you intended.

title: Middle Finger II
description: Make a clamp using only the middle finger and thumb, but with the hand supinated (palm facing up).

title: The Sailor
description: Simulate that the ground is water and you have to balance on a boat. Undulating movements.

title: The Hot Dam
description: Imagine that the dam you are going to touch is on fire. You can only grab it with your fingertips and let go quickly.

title: The Engineer
description: Make up a block with the wall holds and do it. You must choose at least 5 holds and a top.

title: The Zombie
description: Climb with your arms stretched and rigid, like a zombie. Without bending elbows.

title: Magic Touch
description: Before grabbing the next hold, touch your forehead with the hand you are going to grab.

title: Arrowhead II
description: Make a 'deadpoint' towards a prey, but stay in the air for 1 second at the highest point before landing on it.

title: The Strongman
description: Do 5 pull-ups on a bar or large hold before starting the block.

title: The Social Climber
description: Make a block and ask 3 different people to encourage you. You have to pay attention to them and smile.

title: Head Balance II
description: Now rest your chin on the wall to gain balance in one step.

title: The Challenger
description: Find someone who is climbing and propose a duel: the same block, the one who chains it first (or the one who goes the furthest) wins.

title: The Owl II
description: Now look back over your shoulder to see the next foot hold.

title: The Star
description: Separate your arms and legs as far as possible in one step, forming an X with your body.

title: The Chameleon
description: Change your climbing style with each movement: a static one, a dynamic one, an opposition one, etc.

title: Ring finger
description: Use only the ring finger of each hand to grab a prey (the rest, straight or in a fist).

title: The Horseman
description: Ride a volume as if it were a horse, holding it with both hands and legs at the same time.

title: The Speleologist II
description: Climb a block indoors, but with your head completely back, looking at the ground the entire time.

title: The Mobile Gripper
description: Pinch a hold and, without releasing it, rotate your wrist 180 degrees while maintaining your grip.

title: The General
description: Give orders to a partner while climbing. Ex: 'Left hand to the red one!', 'Right foot to the volume!'. He must obey.

title: The Mime III
description: Climb without looking at anything at all. A partner guides you with his voice and by touching your limbs.

title: The Artist II
description: Make a block imitating the climbing style of an animal (monkey, bear, frog, etc.).

title: Leap of Faith II
description: Throw a dynamic at a distant prey, but with your eyes closed. (Make sure you have a spotter).

title: The Fisherman
description: Carry a small magnet and 'fish' for a metal hold (if there is one) while climbing.

title: The Long Distance Runner
description: Do 5 low level blocks, one after the other, with hardly any rest (less than 30 seconds between them).

title: The Rock
description: Hold a tense position in a slump for 10 seconds without moving.

title: The Builder
description: Write down 3 blocks that you would like to have in the climbing wall. Describe them to someone.

title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
description: Do a spell with your hands before each movement (random gestures).

title: Index finger
description: Use only the index finger of each hand to grab a hold.

title: The Mole III
description: Dig into the pocket magnesium and draw a happy face on the catch before releasing it.

title: The Trapeze Artist
description: Go from one block to another through the air, without touching the ground, using a lateral dynamic.

title: Lead Feet II
description: Now keep your heels against the wall at all times.

title: The King of the Plug
description: Make 3 ruler blocks in a row. (If there aren't any, look for the smallest ones).

title: The wanted
description: Escape from an imaginary block that is chasing you. Move quickly and decisively.

title: The Wall
description: Protect a point on the wall with your body so that a partner can pass underneath or next to it.

title: The Yogi
description: Take 3 deep breaths (inhale and exhale loudly) before each movement.

title: The Hunter
description: Choose a color and 'hunt' (touch) 5 prey of that color in ascending order of difficulty.

title: The Child
description: Make a starter block (level 1) with the enthusiasm and excitement of a child starting out.

title: Iron Hand II
description: Keep one hand on a small edge while moving your feet 3 times without letting go.

title: The Traveler
description: Make a block in each area of ​​the climbing wall (plate, drop, dihedral, ceiling) in the same session.

title: The Liar
description: Tell someone that bouldering is a lot easier than it looks. Then try it.

title: The Tightrope walker II
description: Cross a volume by walking on it without using your hands, but now with your eyes closed.

title: The Pharaoh
description: Climb with your arms crossed over your chest in a plate step (feet only).

title: The Astrologer II
description: Before each movement, close your eyes, turn around and open your eyes to see where you land. Move towards that dam.

title: The Physicist
description: Calculate the angle of your body with respect to the wall in a lunge step. (Approximate it).

title: The Spider II
description: Climb always maintaining 3 points of contact, but now with the contact points close to the wall (not separated).

title: The Titan II
description: Choose a high grade block. This time you can try as many times as you want, but only for 10 minutes straight.

title: The Magnet
description: Imagine that your hands are magnets and the grips are metal. You have to 'stick' to them gently.

title: The Mimic
description: Imitate the sound of a different animal with each movement.

title: The Horseman II
description: Now ride a volume as if it were a bull and hold it for 5 seconds without falling.

title: The Postman II
description: Pick up an object from the ground without getting off the block (with your hand or foot).

title: The Astronaut II
description: Move in super slow motion (5 seconds per movement). The partner keeps the time.

title: The King of Bouldering
description: Today it is not worth giving up. If a block resists, you keep trying until you chain it. (Max 15 attempts).

title: The Dance
description: Make a block as if you were dancing, with rhythm and ease. No sudden movements.

title: The Acrobat II
description: Do a forward roll on the mat right after touching the top.

title: The General II
description: Now you are the soldier. Obey the orders of a teammate who shouts at you from the ground.

title: Support Point II
description: Choose a resting point on the block. You can only rest there, and you must do so for at least 10 seconds.

title: The Wall
description: Make a plate block where the feet can only go to standing holds and the hands can only go to hand holds. Mixing is prohibited.

title: The Strongman II
description: Do 10 push-ups before starting the block.

title: The Hunter II
description: Choose a prey and 'hunt' it with your hand, but first you must touch the opposite foot with the same hand.

title: The Top Model II
description: Pose for 5 seconds in the most photogenic position on the boulder. Ask a friend to take a photo of you.

title: The Yogi II
description: Take 3 full breaths (ujjayi) on each rest hold.

title: The Kangaroo
description: Take small continuous jumps with your feet together in a horizontal traverse.

title: The Photographer
description: Take a photo of the block from an original angle and show it to someone before climbing it.

title: The King of Romo II
description: Make 3 blunt blocks in a row, but now in a downward direction.

title: The Tightrope walker III
description: Now cross a volume by walking on it without using your hands and with an object on your head (e.g. an empty magneser).

title: The Champion
description: Repeat the hardest block you have ever done.

title: Share
description: Tell someone at the gym what this game is about and invite them to a game.

title: T-Pose
description: Before each movement, get into T-Pose (arms crossed) for 2 seconds to command respect for the wall.

title: This is Panama
description: Shout 'THIS IS PANAMA!' before launching a dynamic. The prey awaits you.

title: Fokin mode
description: Say 'fokin' in front of every word you say while climbing. Ex: 'Fokin prey, fokin foot, fokin top'.

title: La Roce
description: Brush your face against a volume as you climb. It should be uncomfortable but not painful.

title: Ear Kitchen
description: Pay attention to all the advice that a colleague yells at you from the ground, even if it is bad.

title: Airplane Mode (Low Cost Company)
description: Spread your arms and legs like wings, but also look like you're in a turbulent flight.

title: The Garrulo
description: Whistle summer songs while you climb. If you know one from Camela, the better.

title: Crystal Biceps
description: Every time you flex your arm, make a glass breaking noise. 'Crash'

title: Imaginary Weights
description: Before each hold, pretend to lift imaginary weights with the arm you are going to use.

title: The Desktop
description: In the rest area, pretend that you are having an after-dinner meal: burp, relax and say 'how good it is here'.

title: The Embrace
description: Hug a volume with all your strength for 5 seconds before continuing.

title: Wall Mode
description: Choose a smooth wall without holds. You have to do 3 adhesion movements with your feet only.

title: The Atomic Ant
description: Carry a grain of magnesium from one hold to another with your free hand while climbing.

title: The Paseillo
description: Before starting, do a little walk like a bullfighter along the edge of the mattress, greeting the imaginary audience.

title: Super Warrior
description: Shout as if you were transforming into a legendary warrior before the hardest move. Bonus for trembling.

title: The Invisible
description: Ask a partner to hold your pole while you climb. You can't use it.

title: Sunday Dress
description: Climb with a piece of clothing worn inside out. If not, with the cats changed feet.

title: Radar Mode
description: Make 'beep beep' with your mouth every time you look at new prey. Like sonar.

title: The Bear Hug
description: Surround a large volume with arms and legs at the same time. Hold 5 seconds.

title: The Siesta
description: Lie face up on the mattress 1 minute before starting. Really relax.

title: North Bottom
description: Point north before each movement. If you don't know where it is, make it up.

title: The Skin
description: Scale without magnesium in your hands. Sweat to power. The wall hates you.

title: Submarine mode
description: Puff out your cheeks and hold your breath while doing 2 movements in a row.

title: The Koala
description: On a crash block, stick to a volume and don't move for 5 seconds. Just hug.

title: The Tertullian
description: While resting on a dam, have a serious conversation with someone on the ground.

title: Witch Breakdown
description: Every time you miss a move, say 'breakdown!' and touches the wall with his head.

title: The Poacher
description: Hunt for prey of a color other than that of the block. You have to include it no matter what.

title: Selfie mode
description: Take out your phone and take a selfie in the strangest position on the block. Without falling.

title: The Duck
description: Squat across the mattress from one block to the next. Like a duck.

title: The Visor
description: Place your hand on your forehead, as if looking at the horizon, before each movement.

title: Beast Mode
description: He shows his teeth and growls like an animal before each difficult prey.

title: The Catcher
description: Every time you move a hand, say 'caught' as if you were catching a bug.

title: Sponge Mode
description: Absorb as much magnesium as you can from your pocket and clap your hands before each hold. White cloud.

title: The Caller
description: Calls prey by name before grabbing it. 'Come here, round!'

title: The Clumsy Tightrope Walker
description: You pretend to fall, but catch yourself at the last moment. Theaters.

title: The Collector
description: Pick up 3 imaginary stones from the ground and place them on a hold while climbing.

title: Robot Mode
description: Climb using robotic movements, with pauses between joints. 'Ñec-ñec'.

title: The Whisperer
description: Whisper 'I love you' to each prey before releasing it. The romantic tone is valued.

title: The Star of the Sea
description: In a plate step, spread your arms and legs as far as possible and stick your body to the wall. 5 seconds.

title: The Delivery Boy
description: Carry a magnesero from one block to another without using your hands (with your mouth, elbow...).

title: Slow Motion Mode with Stutter
description: Move in slow motion, but make each movement in fits and starts, like a video that sticks.

title: The Photographer
description: Take a photo of the block with your mind. Say 'click' with your mouth before each movement.

title: The Cobra II
description: Before grabbing prey, pretend to touch it with your head and retreat quickly. Like a cobra.

title: The Presenter
description: Present each prey out loud as if it were a luxury guest. 'And now, with you, the big yellow prey!'

title: Chicken Mode
description: Every time you are afraid in a step, say 'co-co-co!' and bend over a little.

title: The Mountaineer
description: Put on an empty backpack and climb with it. It's not worth taking it off.

title: The Fly
description: Take the magnesium out of your pocket and spread it through the air as if you were a fly with flour.

title: The Crybaby
description: Simulate crying before a difficult movement. 'Wow, I can't.' And then you do it.

title: Turtle Mode
description: Climb so slowly that it seems like you are not moving forward. 15 seconds per minimum movement.

title: The Ventriloquist
description: Give your hands a doll voice. Talk to them. 'Come on, right hand, you can do it.'

title: The Croquette Tightrope Walker
description: Cross a volume by rolling on yourself (like a kibble) instead of walking.

title: The Nightmare
description: Close your eyes and let a partner put your hands and feet on the holds. Total blind scale.

title: The Clown
description: Put a pin or funny object on your clothes. If you take it off, challenge failed.

title: 21st Century Ninja Mode
description: Scale without making noise, but looking at the mobile at the same time (home screen).

title: The Jumper
description: Do 3 jumps on the mattress before starting. Like a boxer.

title: Silly Laughter
description: Climb smiling all the time. If your smile fades, challenge failed.

title: The Coconut Eater
description: Before each movement, say the name of a food. It has to be varied.

title: Blackout Mode
description: Close your eyes and do 2 movements blindly. Open, look, close again.

title: The Statue
description: In the most uncomfortable position on the block, stay still for 10 seconds. Almost without breathing.

title: Bingo
description: Call the bingo: 'Line!' when you get halfway, 'Bingo!' when you get to the top.

title: Crane Mode
description: Raise one leg straight back and hold it there for 2 hand movements.

title: The Spinning Top
description: Turn 360 degrees on one foot on a large hold. If you fall, to the ground.

title: The Nail
description: Climb a block using only the tips of your fingers, without supporting the entire pad.

title: The Swimmer
description: Do swimming stroke movements in the air before each catch.

title: Karateka Mode
description: Gives a sharp blow to the prey with its hand before grabbing it. 'Hyah!'

title: Teleportation
description: Close your eyes, say the name of a prey and open them. Your partner must have moved you there. No, wait, it doesn't work. Try it.

title: Dragon Ball
description: Put your hands together and shout 'KAME HAME HA!' before a dynamic. The shock wave is assessed.

title: The Announcement
description: Make the advertising spot before starting: 'And now, we return to you, THE BLOCK'.

title: Penguin Mode
description: Walk from one side of the mattress to the other with your feet together, like a penguin, before you begin.

title: The Jester
description: Bow to the audience before you start and after the top. The audience is you and your colleagues.

title: Apnea
description: Hold your breath while doing 3 movements in a row. Hyperventilate before.

title: The Wedge
description: Get between two people who are climbing different blocks and make your own. Uncomfortable

title: Reflective Mode
description: Put on sunglasses and climb. If there is sun, the better. If not, it doesn't matter, you look cool.

title: The Crier
description: Tout your block as if you were in the market: 'Ladies and gentlemen, level 2 block, with round dams!'

title: The Starfish II
description: Now in a collapse: separate yourself from the wall with only your arms and legs, like a star. 5 seconds.

title: The Baby
description: Crawl across the mattress to the block. Yes, on all fours, like a baby.

title: Flare Mode
description: Take magnesium out of your pocket and throw it in the air like you're a rock star. White cloud.

title: The Piano
description: Play piano on holds before grabbing them. 'Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, si, DO!'.

title: The Mummy II
description: He climbs with stiff arms and legs, but also with a lost look, like a mummy that wakes up.

title: The Rooster
description: Crow like a rooster before the key movement. 'KIKIRIKÍ!'

title: Bubble Mode
description: Imagine that you are inside a bubble and you cannot touch it with the wall. Separate the body a little.

title: The Sleeper
description: Yawns exaggeratedly before each movement. It doesn't matter if you're sleepy or not.

title: The Traca Tightrope walker
description: Cross a volume walking, but at the end, do a stunt: jump and spin in the air. 'BOOM, BAM, BAM!'

title: The Nightmare II
description: Close your eyes and a partner gives you false instructions on purpose. Survive.

title: The Diver III
description: Make the movement of coming out to breathe: raise your head, open your mouth and take a deep breath before each movement.

title: Alarm Mode
description: Set an alarm on your cell phone that sounds after 30 seconds. You have to get to the top before it rings.

title: The Broken Mirror
description: Make one movement and then the next one has to be the exact reflection (e.g. right hand up, then left hand down symmetrical).

title: The Crane III
description: Raise one leg forward, straight, and hold it there for 2 hand movements.

title: The Mime VII
description: Pretend you are trapped in a glass box while climbing. You touch the wall but as if you can't get through.

title: Puss in Boots II
description: Put one shoe on your hand and one hand on your foot. Okay, no. But put your cats on your feet.

title: The Astrologer III
description: Look at the ceiling, walk around, and the first prey you see when you lower your head is the next one. Total random.

title: The Serpent
description: Scale, undulating your hips like a snake in each movement. Rhythm.

title: Video Clip Mode
description: Pretend to be recorded for a video clip while climbing. Exaggerated, sensual or epic, you choose.

title: The Lighthouse Keeper
description: Before each movement, spin your hand like a lighthouse. 'Brr brr'.

title: The Weight
description: Before you start, put on a backpack with some weight (a bottle of water, a small dumbbell).

title: The Watcher II
description: Point to each hold before using it and say its color out loud. Like a ship's lookout.

title: The Broom
description: Imagine you have a broom and you are sweeping the wall as you go up. Wide movements.

title: The Slip
description: Simulate that you slip on every standing hold, but recover. Theater.

title: Final Boss Mode
description: Jump and roll to the block, as if you were a video game character. At least 5 jumps.

title: Random Time
description: Challenge a random person to climb a block, to win you have to complete it in less time than him.
